create.name: Shakti Sutriasa
create.bio:
Shakti Sutriasa is a meditation teacher, life coach, writer and artist who lives on Bainbridge Island in Washington State and works with people over Zoom. She holds master's degrees in education and in social work, has practised as a licensed clinical social worker since 2013, the year she set up her practice, Decide Differently, and has also studied many of the world's religious traditions. She trained in happiness and success coaching with Robert Holden and is certified in Neuro-Emotional Technique.

Her spiritual teaching centres on guided meditation and prayer. On YouTube and in her Love's Refuge podcast she offers meditations and visualisations for coming home to a sense of safety, trust and love: calling on the goddess Tara, the Chidakash breath and metta, kundalini awakening, forgiveness and letting go of fear. She has taught classes on happiness, gratitude and forgiveness, and a weekly email shares prayers and practices. Her six-month coaching programme blends goal setting, affirmation, visualisation, body-based work and soul retrieval, aimed at helping clients live with more purpose and joy. Alongside this she writes and makes sculpture, baskets, enamel work and jewellery, which she sees as part of bringing the sacred into daily life.

courses.title: Life Coaching Programme
courses.description: A six-month, one-to-one coaching programme of 18 sessions on Zoom, tailored to what each client wants from life. She draws on goal setting, affirmation, visualisation, body-based techniques and soul retrieval work. A free introductory chat comes first, and there is a waiting list for 2027.

free_resources.title: Love's Refuge Podcast
free_resources.description: Her free podcast of spiritual tools, mostly guided meditations, for stepping out of fear and back into peace, trust and a felt connection with your true self.
